prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONE full fidelity, production-quality desktop web app first viewport as a flat, straight-on landscape UI screen, target 1440x1000. No device bezel, no perspective, no outside scenery.

STRUCTURE in order: 64px compact top navigation; 110px page title region; below that a 220px left vertical benchmark index, a wide 900px central chart canvas, and a narrow 190px model control rail; directly below the chart, a compact result ledger, then a low-key source footer. The chart is the dominant first viewport region with 400px plot height, large enough to clearly read the curves. This is a premium Operate application whose task is selecting a benchmark, comparing models' capability versus measured task cost, and checking result sources.

WORLD: pale silver page #f3f5f6, white plotting canvas, graphite #16252c text, emerald #16715e selected controls. Modern clear Geist/system-like sans typography, precise type hierarchy, generous measured spacing, polished thin subtle gray separators, discreet 6-12px radii. Crisp real readable controls. Restrained premium software interface with no ornamental content. No decorative photography, blueprint motifs, KPI cards, huge marketing hero, oversized navigation, drop-shadow card grid, promotional claims, invented factual values, release dates or rankings.

TOP: small restrained brand name "AI Benchmarks" at left with a simple small emerald geometric mark; compact navigation "Benchmarks" active, "Models", "Methodology", and "GitHub" link on right. Main exact title "AI Benchmarks" large 36px, exact small subtitle "Compare capability. Understand the cost."

LEFT INDEX: quiet small label "BENCHMARK INDEX"; expanded group "Coding" with DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0, FrontierCode 1.1 selected in pale emerald background with emerald text and narrow emerald left accent, CursorBench 4.0. Below them collapsed labels "Reasoning", "Knowledge work", "Vision" with small chevrons. Sidebar starts aligned with central heading and has no chunky box.

CENTRAL: heading "FrontierCode 1.1", secondary "Main set · Published by Anthropic". Horizontal compact segmented control: "Score vs. cost" selected emerald, "Results" inactive. Small quiet exact note "Design preview · source values verified in build". Main white chart, no graph title repeated. Horizontal log axis labeled "Cost per task (USD)" with ticks $0.25, $0.50, $1, $2, $5, $10, $20; vertical "Score (%)" ticks 20,30,40,50,60. Very faint horizontal grid lines. THREE thin straight polylines with round markers, never smooth spline curves: Sonnet 5.5 blue approximate points (cost .20, score29.2),(.25,36.5),(.42,49.4),(1.59,52.1),(20.78,46.2). Opus 5.5 orange approximate (.41,47.3),(.82,54.6),(1.10,54.0),(2.24,51.4),(6.10,54.4). GPT-6 Sol muted gray approximate (.43,37.3),(.76,45.9),(1.04,47.7),(1.33,48.4),(2.07,49.3). Curves accurate in shape; chart only design preview, not official data screenshot. A compact colored model legend near the bottom of plot. No exact data point annotations.

RIGHT RAIL: heading "Models", small "3 selected". Three checked boxes and colored line dots for Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Sol. Other unchecked options GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Luna, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, Fable each with muted "Not reported" below. Each option orderly with enough line height to read, narrow but never clipped.

RESULT LEDGER: below plot under central region, title "Reported results", a compact clean table with columns Model / Evaluation / Source. Rows Opus 5.5 / Main set / Anthropic external-link icon; Sonnet 5.5 / Main set / Anthropic external-link icon; GPT-6 Sol / Main set / Anthropic external-link icon. No fabricated numerical cells. Low-key row separators, 40px rows, clear source links.

FOOTER: source link "View source ↗" and exact sentence "Missing results are never treated as zero." Maintain clean app hierarchy and sober data honesty. All typography should be fully legible and correctly spelled. Deliver one polished implementation-ready full viewport UI comp in landscape.
deviations: Native render 1505x1045 instead of target 1440x1000; imagegen subtitle spells Anthropic imperfectly; semantic build must correct it.
